summary: A leave letter/application generator tool with an input form featuring multiple fields (recipient type, language, name, parent/guardian, school, class, leave dates, duration, reason, absent since, medical certificate) and an output section with generated letter display.
architectural_notes: Input form uses CSS grid: grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr) with gap:16px; collapses to 1fr below 768px

Field layout: Row1(Recipient Type, Language, Your Name), Row2(Parent/Guardian, School/College, Class/Grade), Row3(Leave Dates, Duration Type, Reason), Row4(Absent Since, Medical Certificate Checkbox, empty)

existing_features.title: Redesign the Input Section of LeaveApplicationPage.tsx to use a CSS grid layout with `display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 16px;` instead of the current full-width stacked layout. Arrange all form fields into exactly 4 rows as follows — Row 1: Recipient Type, Language, Your Name; Row 2: Parent/Guardian Name, School/College Name, Class/Grade; Row 3: Leave Date(s), Leave Duration Type, Reason for Leave; Row 4: Absent Since (Date), Medical Certificate Checkbox, empty third column (use an empty div placeholder or leave the cell unstyled). Do NOT change any form field functionality, values, state, or handlers.

Remove full-width input styling from all fields in the Input Section. Each input, select/dropdown, and checkbox group must respect its grid cell width. Remove any `width: 100%` or equivalent overrides that cause inputs to stretch beyond their grid cell. Ensure all dropdowns and text inputs have a consistent visual width matching their respective grid columns.

Add a responsive breakpoint to the Input Section grid: on screens with viewport width below 768px, switch the grid to a single-column layout using `grid-template-columns: 1fr`, stacking all fields vertically.

Fix the spacing between the Input Section card and the Output Section. Remove unnecessary `margin-bottom` from the Input card, remove extra padding below the output action buttons, and ensure the output buttons sit close to the bottom edge of the output card. The overall vertical rhythm should be balanced with no excessive white space between the two sections.

new_feature_requests.summary: Redesign Input Section with 3-column CSS grid layout (repeat(3,1fr), gap:16px), 4 rows of fields, responsive single-column below 768px, and fix output section spacing
